defaultPrompt: Initialize this product with Product OS and recommend P1, P2, or P3.
Review the current Product OS phase and show what blocks the next gate.
Trace this change across requirements, design, architecture, tests, and evidence.
Compose the active phase into the governed P1, P2, or P3 repository structure after showing a dry-run.
